title: Dotted Tulle Off-Shoulder Maternity Photoshoot Gown

seo_desc: Off-shoulder maternity photoshoot gown in dotted tulle with sheer balloon sleeves and a sweeping skirt. 6 colors, US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: an off-the-shoulder gown in soft dotted tulle with sheer balloon sleeves, an empire waist that sits above the bump, and a full skirt that sweeps into a short train when you move or twirl.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 10 days, so please allow about 22-26 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
sweetheart neckline, gathered bodice, long sheer sleeves worn off the shoulders, and a sheer dotted-tulle skirt over a short lining.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
Dusty Blue, Black, White, Champagne Gold, Pink and Red.
Hand wash cold or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam on low to remove creases.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Choose by your bust today; the empire waist and full skirt leave room for the bump. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.
garment_lock: an off-the-shoulder maternity gown with a sweetheart neckline and gathered bodice, long sheer balloon (bishop) sleeves with ruffled cuffs worn off the shoulders, an empire waist over the bump, and a very full, floor-sweeping skirt of sheer tulle sprinkled with small tonal flocked dots, with a short train; a short opaque lining under the sheer skirt

DRESS LIKE MOMMY — RELIABLE PHOTOSHOOT SYSTEM (automated run)

The dots are small, matte and darker blue, scattered all over the bodice, sleeves and skirt.

Generate FOUR separate images in this order and save each into the current working directory with exactly these names:
- image1.png — IMAGE 1, MAIN HERO: a visibly pregnant woman (about 7 months) standing in a bright, softly lit photo studio with a plain light backdrop, wearing this gown, one hand on her bump, the other lifting the skirt so the dotted tulle fans out; full length, front-facing, gown in sharp focus.
- image3.png — IMAGE 3, BEST OCCASION: the same woman at an outdoor maternity photoshoot in a meadow at golden hour, the tulle skirt and sleeves moving in the breeze; full length.
- image5.png — IMAGE 5, PRODUCT-ONLY: no people. The gown displayed on a white dress form (mannequin) in a bright studio, skirt spread around the base, showing the off-shoulder neckline, sheer balloon sleeves and the dotted tulle clearly.
- image6.png — IMAGE 6, ALTERNATE LIFESTYLE: the same pregnant woman on a beach at sunset with her partner (a man in a plain white shirt and beige trousers) standing behind her with his hands on her bump; she wears the gown; three-quarter length.
Do not ask me anything; continue until all four files are saved. Keep the same woman across images 1, 3 and 6.

Each output: one single vertical 9:16 photo, no collage, no borders, no text, no watermark. Crop minimally to 9:16 if needed.
PRODUCT LOCK: dusty blue colour, off-the-shoulder sweetheart neckline, long sheer balloon sleeves with ruffled cuffs worn off the shoulders, empire waist, very full floor-length sheer dotted tulle skirt with a short train. No logos, no letters, no extra embellishment, no belt, no sequins.
MODEL STYLE: a natural-looking European woman, fair to light-medium skin, warm smile, tasteful and elegant; a different woman from the reference photos.
STRICT QUALITY CHECK before saving: reject and regenerate if the gown design or colour changed, the dots are missing, she does not look pregnant, extra text appears, it is a collage, not 9:16, or it looks fake.
When all four files are saved, reply with one line per file: name, width x height.
